resolved_findings.title: coordinator whole identity refresh
resolved_findings.evidence: Fixed actual ContentIdentity is re-resolved before every retry including done, and before consume_live_completion. Full actual dictionary must equal the retained identity; original actual Battle/Mission/credited token recapture remains.

resolved_findings.title: retained preference wake
resolved_findings.evidence: Requested preferences are retained while startup/progress/shared profile is blocked. Actual startup_complete and progress_committed after Gate.leave schedule only one process-frame callback; shared confirmation also resumes pending preferences.

resolved_findings.title: visible original Cloud retry
resolved_findings.evidence: Shared profile proposal, phase, original/target owner, binding digest and initial complete identity are retained in the actual root Cloud. Flow displays config failure and invokes this same object; Campaign retains original CFG writer.

resolved_findings.title: authorized A-to-B retry
resolved_findings.evidence: Cloud operation retries require actual root Cloud script and its _applying permission, same frozen original owner and target/current Steam account. The original owner may remain A until durable CFG publication; no forced premature owner relabeling.

resolved_findings.title: all mirror and shared preference gates
resolved_findings.evidence: _store_mirror and _remember_local guard Gate, Campaign pending writer and shared profile pending; quit also refuses shared pending. Local apply_payload(false) reaches the same lower mirror guard. Campaign deferred/private preference writers retain/reject while shared configuration is pending.

resolved_findings.title: pre-proposal and partial release ownership
resolved_findings.evidence: Explicit _preproposal_release represents own pre-proposal lock failures. No frozen/staged/pending proposal can be aborted. OwnedRelease verifies actual retained nonce/metadata before first removal, then retains exact instance/path/lock_raw/head SHA and verifies empty writing before retrying only directory removal; malformed/unknown metadata is never recreated.

resolved_findings.title: retained startup CFG recovery
resolved_findings.evidence: Non-progress startup recovery retains _startup_cfg and exact original record. Subsequent retry uses this same busy object after actual installed/account/owner checks; every original proposal field except generation/state must match.

resolved_findings.title: no false empty CFG startup
resolved_findings.evidence: Recovering residue is refused, zero-head writing without exact own proposal context is refused, and foreign writing is read-only inspected with actual PID before status/recovery. Fresh startup cannot classify these residues as no pending.

resolved_findings.title: initial binding proposal preservation
resolved_findings.evidence: Before the first marker write the full canonical proposal, raw source, actual installed identity, original owner and current binding SHA are retained. Explicit marker -> apply -> close stages retain failure and provide a visible same-object retry.

resolved_findings.title: unknown temporary binding preservation
resolved_findings.evidence: The common binding write entry rejects existing OWNER_PATH.tmp file or directory, covering first marker, first close and every retry; unknown/half-written bytes are retained.

resolved_findings.title: fresh exact shared close confirmation
resolved_findings.evidence: After successful shared application, close freezes stable raw SHA/size for campaign.cfg/settings.cfg/language.cfg plus exact target owner and runtime/canonical progress. Actual CFG owner/schema/unlocked/records and actual Settings/Localize text must match. First close and all close retries read the same confirmed state; drift does not become a new baseline.

resolved_findings.title: valid raw input to one canonical write target
resolved_findings.evidence: The raw validated source is kept separately in _pending_shared_source_profile. Before attach marker or generic application, the fixed existing _merged_campaign({}, campaign) canonicalizes one source without unioning goals from separate runs. CFG, normalized Campaign state and frozen write target therefore share one representation; all strict close/digest/owner checks remain.

original_R2_rejected_findings_preserved.title: Retained live terminal retries and completion do not re-resolve installed identity
original_R2_rejected_findings_preserved.trigger: Source or engine bytes drift after a failed terminal/CFG/ACK attempt, or after stage done before completion consumption.
original_R2_rejected_findings_preserved.evidence: ContinueFlow resolves ContentIdentity only when constructing the coordinator. retry, including done return, and consume_live_completion only validate the frozen identity through Profiles structure/context and Intent.capture; they do not read current installed bytes.
original_R2_rejected_findings_preserved.impact: A retained live operation can finish progress, ACK and grant completion against stale source identity.
original_R2_rejected_findings_preserved.required_change: Re-resolve fixed actual ContentIdentity before every retained retry and before consuming completion, comparing the complete actual identity to the immutable initial identity; drift must remain rejected.

original_R2_rejected_findings_preserved.title: Deferred preference snapshot is stranded when progress/startup gate is closed
original_R2_rejected_findings_preserved.trigger: save_prefs is queued during startup or a pending campaign terminal; the callback runs while Gate is closed.
original_R2_rejected_findings_preserved.evidence: _save_prefs_deferred sets _prefs_deferred=false then returns while retaining _prefs_requested. Startup completion and progress_committed do not queue the retained request again.
original_R2_rejected_findings_preserved.impact: Normal requested preferences may never persist unless the user performs another preference save.
original_R2_rejected_findings_preserved.required_change: Wake retained preferences after the actual gate opens and after successful progress closure, without duplicate callbacks and without writing in physics.

original_R2_rejected_findings_preserved.title: A failed cloud CFG writer has no reachable live retry path
original_R2_rejected_findings_preserved.trigger: An ordinary cloud application enters CFG writer and an I/O step fails while the original writer remains busy.
original_R2_rejected_findings_preserved.evidence: Campaign retains the writer, but apply_cloud_progress only returns false; Flow.note_config_failure is called only from deferred preferences. SteamCloud._process/_attach/_pull/_flush all return when Campaign.persistence_busy, so they cannot drive the retained writer.
original_R2_rejected_findings_preserved.impact: Background synchronization and launch remain blocked in-process with no visible original-object cloud retry action.
original_R2_rejected_findings_preserved.required_change: Expose a failure/retry path for the actual root SteamCloud original proposal and original Campaign writer; do not recreate or silently replace the failed operation.

original_R2_rejected_findings_preserved.title: Legitimate A-to-B cloud transition is rejected by retained CFG retry ownership check
original_R2_rejected_findings_preserved.trigger: During a legitimate account A to B transition, CFG replacement fails before Campaign._load publishes B.
original_R2_rejected_findings_preserved.evidence: Cloud permits original_owner A and target_owner B, and keeps Campaign.cloud_owner A until commit. retry_persistence requires cloud_owner == _cfg_writer_scope.target_owner B before retry_write.
original_R2_rejected_findings_preserved.impact: The exact retained authorized cloud transaction cannot recover even if its storage failure is repaired.
original_R2_rejected_findings_preserved.required_change: Bind the original shared-profile owner, target owner, actual root Cloud identity/account and original binding/proposal; authorize that frozen transition without relabeling old data or requiring prematurely published target owner.

original_R2_rejected_findings_preserved.title: Quit and local apply can write scoped cloud mirrors while persistence gate is closed
original_R2_rejected_findings_preserved.trigger: App closes with cloud_ready/dirty while startup/progress/prefs persistence is pending, or apply_payload is invoked with from_cloud=false during pending persistence.
original_R2_rejected_findings_preserved.evidence: _exit_tree calls _remember_local without gate; _remember_local and _store_mirror lack gate/pending checks. apply_payload(false) also directly calls _store_mirror. Guarding _process/_flush does not guard these actual writes.
original_R2_rejected_findings_preserved.impact: A new mirrored profile can be persisted from unconfirmed in-memory state while the campaign source/proposal remains blocked.
original_R2_rejected_findings_preserved.required_change: Enforce Gate and pending checks at the actual mirror write path, including quit and local apply, while preserving authorized frozen cloud retry as a separate validated path.

original_R2_rejected_findings_preserved.title: Owned pre-proposal lock failures with empty active state cannot be retried or released
original_R2_rejected_findings_preserved.trigger: After acquire, a read/scope refusal occurs before _active building is initialized and releasing the own lock also has a transient I/O failure; acquire itself may fail after creating writing.
original_R2_rejected_findings_preserved.evidence: busy remains true from _locked/_lock_created, but preparation_pending requires a nonempty building _active; retry_write rejects empty _active and abort_unprepared also rejects it. No original-object release retry is reachable.
original_R2_rejected_findings_preserved.impact: The retained writer blocks all subsequent writes and launch in-process with CFG_FROZEN_PROPOSAL_REQUIRED even after safe storage repair.
original_R2_rejected_findings_preserved.required_change: Represent and retain a pre-proposal owned release state with exact nonce/head and no frozen/staged/pending proposal. Retry only verification and removal of the exact own lock; do not guess ownership or discard malformed/partially written metadata.

original_R2_rejected_findings_preserved.title: Startup discards the retained non-progress CFG recovery object on failure
original_R2_rejected_findings_preserved.trigger: Startup recovers a pending prefs/cloud CFG; recover_pending enters retry_write, acquires a current-process lock and fails later.
original_R2_rejected_findings_preserved.evidence: cfg is a local ConfigTransaction.new variable. On failure _startup_failed returns without retaining it. retry_startup creates a different object; _head then inspects the still-live original process lock and refuses WRITER_ALIVE. The progress coordinator path does retain objects.
original_R2_rejected_findings_preserved.impact: The startup Retry action cannot repair non-progress CFG recovery in the same process.
original_R2_rejected_findings_preserved.required_change: Retain the startup CFG object and immutable operation/source/owner scope. After fresh actual identity/owner checks, resume that original object; never hand its live lock to a recreated writer.

original_R2_rejected_findings_preserved.title: CFG pending metadata reports zero-generation writing and recovering residue as no pending operation
original_R2_rejected_findings_preserved.trigger: The first CFG writer has created writing/owner.json but no prepared record, or recovering residue exists without writing on an applied/zero head.
original_R2_rejected_findings_preserved.evidence: pending_status returns pending=false for head.revision==0 regardless of writing; the nonzero expression checks writing but omits recovering. It does not inspect actual PID/lock metadata on these omitted states. Startup final checks therefore may open Gate while that residue or an actual other writer remains.
original_R2_rejected_findings_preserved.impact: Startup can report confirmed/unblocked despite unvalidated ownership or an active/pending CFG writer.
original_R2_rejected_findings_preserved.required_change: Read-only classify all writing/recovering/receipt.pending states and inspect exact metadata/PID before declaring none pending. Zero-generation/unknown proposal residue must fail closed; any recovery must be separately scoped and verified.
